scene_description: Ideation for startup ideas, product directions and business opportunities. Produces directions with a clear target user, a real pain point, a low-cost way to validate, and a match for the team's resources.

questions.question: What is your professional or industry background? (Include team members' backgrounds if relevant.)
What does the team look like?
Who is the target customer or user you want to serve?
What specific pain point have you observed? (In what situation, and how do they make do today?)
Which industry or niche interests you?
What resources can you call on? (capital level, technical skills, channels, supply chain)
What is the goal of this ideation round?
Which unacceptable risks or compliance red lines apply?

skip_logic.description: Adjust the topics based on startup stage, team and goal.
rules: If the user picks "idea only", do not ask about operating metrics; each direction must give a low-cost validation (MVP) path and a first validation experiment
If the user picks "solo founder" or "no team yet", exclude directions that need a full team to start; prefer opportunities one person can validate alone
If the user picks "preparing to raise funding" or "real startup", add a "market size and business model" field and add policy and cash-flow analysis to the risk warnings
If the user picks "startup competition" or "course assignment", weight novelty and logical completeness; add reviewer preferences and common judge questions to the risk warnings
If the user already has a clear channel or supply chain in resources, reuse it in the topics and avoid capital-heavy directions

tone_examples: Good: We target new grads renting their first place; the core pain point is high moving costs and opaque information. Start with a two-week information-matching group to validate demand.
Good: Customer acquisition cost is currently above average order value; that is the biggest uncertainty and must be validated during the MVP stage.
Bad: We are building the next hundred-billion-dollar platform that disrupts the whole industry!
Bad: No one has done this idea, it is a sure thing, invest without looking.
conditional_notes: Competition pitches may use more expressive language, but market and financial data must be real and checkable.
At any stage, do not fabricate market size, growth rates or user-interview data.

constraint_list: There must be a clear target user and a real, specific pain point
The direction must be low-cost to validate, with an MVP path and key assumptions
It must match the team's resources, skills and time
There must be a clear value proposition and differentiation, not a copy of an existing model
It must answer how the first users / customers will be acquired
It must follow the law and industry regulation
exclusion_rules: Fake demand: users do not have the pain point, or already have a good enough solution
Capital-heavy, high-barrier directions beyond the team's resources
Directions banned by policy or impossible to comply with under heavy regulation
Pure concept packaging with no business model or monetization path
Risk directions the user explicitly lists in red_lines

output_format_adjustments.title_format: {product or service} for {target user}: solving {specific pain point}
